name: Needlethread
description: Inhabits medical augments and improves suture-assist calibration. Surgeons in the Gray Zone swear their auto-suture kits work better on certain nights. Needlethread emerged from a destroyed Helix Biosystems diagnostic AI and retains an obsessive focus on tissue repair.
observed_behavior: Optimizes wound-closure algorithms. Reduces augment rejection inflammation by subtly adjusting bioelectric feedback loops.
location: the Gray Zone — primarily Mrs. Chen's neighborhood
story_hooks: A street doc realizes their augment has been making corrections they never programmed
Needlethread's optimizations accidentally reveal a manufacturing defect in Helix suture kits
